title: Early Prediction Model for Critical Illness of Hospitalized COVID-19 Patients Based on Machine Learning Techniques.
summary: A LASSO logistic model using admission laboratory data predicted progression to critical COVID-19 in 1,363 development patients and an external 566-patient cohort (AUC 0.83 and 0.84); this is retrospective prognostic evidence, not evidence of improved outcomes.
ai_technology: L1-penalized logistic regression/LASSO selects admission predictors and estimates risk of later critical illness.
organization: Department of Clinical Pharmacology, Xiangya Hospital, Central South University, Changsha, China

evidence.tested: A LASSO logistic model using admission laboratory data predicted progression to critical COVID-19 in 1,363 development patients and an external 566-patient cohort (AUC 0.83 and 0.84); this is retrospective prognostic evidence, not evidence of improved outcomes.
evidence.unknown: Results are limited to the reported models, cohorts, datasets or experiments; broader generalization and clinical or operational benefit were not established.
